description: BUNKER MINI 2.0 V1 multi-contact tracked-plant surrogate. Measured geometry is separated from uncalibrated simulation assumptions.

measured_fixed.source: assets/ugv_gazebo_sim/bunker/bunker_mini/meshes/base_link.STL, reproduced by scripts/analyze_bunker_geometry.py; mass properties are from the Isaac Sim URDF import

reference_only.note: Manual curb mass is a future calibration target, not used as V1 physical truth.

derived_symmetry_overrides.basis: The imported STL-derived COM Y and principal-axis quaternion X/Z terms are tiny mirror-odd numerical residues. V1 zeros only those components to enforce exact left/right plant symmetry while preserving imported mass, diagonal inertia, COM X/Z, and the meaningful principal-axis Y rotation.

drive_sign_by_side.basis: Both revolute axes are authored as +Y in the unrotated base frame. At the bottom contact, positive angular velocity gives surface velocity -X, so ground reaction drives the body +X.

notes: All values in tunable_assumptions are initial numerical choices, not measured BUNKER properties.
Rollers are contact discretization elements and do not represent the real road-wheel count or belt-link geometry.
The radius is half of flat_contact_length / roller_count, so adjacent cylinders tile the measured flat interval in X.
Rigid rollers cannot reproduce belt compliance, grouser engagement, soil deformation, or continuous-track shear distribution.
The simplified chassis box can miss body-ground contacts made by the detailed shell.
Roller masses are subtracted from the imported base mass so total authored V1 mass remains the imported 40.953842 kg. Imported base inertia is retained as an approximation.
